$comment: Hand-written engineering log for /testing, in public language: what was tested, what was seen, what changed. No names, tools, suppliers, prices or datasheet figures. sync-testing.mjs validates it and copies published entries into public/testing/index.json. figureId must name a published figure.

items.tested: Thrust map, one 6S pack, ten holds.
items.saw: 1652 g at 31283 rpm at 100 percent; ESC temperature live. The 16:35 UTC capture is not used: zero drift up to 27 g.
items.changed: ESC temperature stays live after a pack swap.

items.tested: Thrust map on the new stand, ten holds.
items.saw: 13:25 UTC: 1496 g at 100 percent. 13:16 UTC: the operator unplugged the pack at 80 percent because of the noise.
items.changed: Bench controller aborts when bus voltage disappears.

items.tested: Continuous current rating by a current step.
items.saw: Not captured: a 20 s step reaches only a few percent of the steady rise.
items.changed: Bench holds a target die temperature instead.

items.tested: Review of the scope captures of the ramp session.
items.saw: Scope channel 1 read one constant value in all nine sessions.

items.tested: Throttle sweep against a clamp reference.
items.saw: Sense reading did not track the clamp: 11.6 A against 32.4 A at 80 percent.
items.changed: Input network added in rev3.2; no capture after it.

items.tested: One channel ramped to full throttle, no thermal guard.
items.saw: Clamp current peaked at 39.8 A, die at 156 C; telemetry stopped at 161 C.

items.tested: First boards flashed for the bench.
items.saw: Boards left flashing with the temperature limit at 255 and a default motor preset.
items.changed: Both now set per product in the flashing jig.

items.tested: First flights of the full stack on five drones.
items.saw: 103 blackbox logs from four drones; the fifth SD card failed.

items.tested: Ride out to 5.3 km, Gemini and Mono on one carry.
items.saw: Beyond 2.9 km the Gemini had lower RSSI in 24 of 25 bins, higher link quality in all 25.
